blobstores.tile.title: Blob stores
blobstores.tile.description: Where repositories keep their files: folders, S3 buckets and groups of stores
blobstores.types.fileText: A folder on the file system of the server.
blobstores.types.s3Text: A bucket in Amazon S3 or in a service compatible with it.
blobstores.types.groupText: Several file or S3 stores used as one; new blobs go to the members by a fill policy.
blobstores.list.title: Blob stores
blobstores.list.description: The files of components live in blob stores. A repository keeps its files in the store chosen when it was created.
blobstores.list.name: Name
blobstores.list.emptyText: Create one before the first repository: every repository keeps its files in a blob store.
blobstores.create.title: Create a blob store
blobstores.create.description: Choose where the blobs are kept.
blobstores.form.name: Name
blobstores.form.nameHint: Letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'. It cannot be changed later.
blobstores.form.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
blobstores.form.errors.namePattern: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'; the name cannot start with '_' or '.'
blobstores.form.errors.bucketRequired: Enter the name of the bucket
blobstores.form.errors.bucketPattern: Use 3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits, '.' and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit
blobstores.form.errors.expiration: Enter a whole number of days, or -1
blobstores.form.errors.keyIdRequired: Enter the access key ID that goes with the secret
blobstores.form.errors.endpoint: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host
blobstores.file.pathHint: An absolute path, or a path inside the blobs folder of the data directory. It must not lie inside or around another store.
blobstores.s3.bucketText: The bucket and the place in it where the blobs are kept. They cannot change once the store holds blobs.
blobstores.s3.bucketHint: Created when it does not exist yet.
blobstores.s3.regionHint: For example eu-central-1; DEFAULT takes the region from the environment.
blobstores.s3.prefixHint: A folder in the bucket for this store; empty uses the whole bucket.
blobstores.s3.expirationHint: -1 keeps deleted blobs; kept for a lifecycle rule of the bucket.
blobstores.s3.credentialsText: Leave them empty to use the credentials the server finds in its environment, profile or instance role.
blobstores.s3.roleHint: The ARN of an IAM role the server assumes with these credentials.
blobstores.s3.sessionTokenHint: Only for temporary credentials. Left empty, a stored token is kept while the access key ID stays the same.
blobstores.s3.kmsKeyHint: Empty uses the key AWS manages for S3.
blobstores.s3.endpointHint: For a service compatible with S3, such as MinIO; empty uses AWS.
blobstores.s3.pathStyleHint: The bucket goes into the path instead of the host name; most services compatible with S3 need it.
blobstores.group.text: Reads look in every member; new blobs go to a member chosen by the fill policy.
blobstores.group.membersHint: File or S3 stores that are in no other group and serve no repository. A member that holds blobs cannot be removed.
blobstores.group.noCandidates: No other blob store can join: a member must be a file or S3 store in no group, serving no repository.
blobstores.group.fillPolicyHint: Which member receives a new blob.
blobstores.group.writeToFirst: The first member that can take it
blobstores.quota.title: Soft quota
blobstores.quota.text: Raises a warning when the store passes the limit; uploads are not refused.
blobstores.quota.usedHint: Warn when the store holds more than this.
blobstores.quota.remainingHint: Warn when less than this is free.
blobstores.edit.memberOf: It is a member of the group {groups}.
blobstores.edit.cannotDelete: It cannot be deleted while it is in use.
blobstores.edit.unavailable: The server cannot reach this blob store. Check its settings and the storage behind it.
blobstores.edit.unsupported: This type of blob store is not supported
blobstores.edit.unsupportedText: The server keeps blobs in file, S3 and group stores; {type} stores cannot be managed here.
blobstores.edit.notFound: There is no blob store named {name} of this type.
blobstores.edit.note: Changes apply at once. A store that holds blobs cannot change its path, bucket or prefix.
blobstores.delete.title: Delete the blob store {name}?
blobstores.delete.text: Its configuration is removed. A file store's folder is removed when it is empty; an S3 bucket is left as it is. This cannot be undone.
